scope: Read-only review of import fidelity, register completeness and editorial/media commissioning honesty. Only these review artifacts are authored; no console access or writes. This is not paragraph-by-paragraph historical fact checking, a fresh decode audit or an on-device review.
passed_checks: All raw article IDs are unique; production and media registers cover exactly the 1,064 distinct destinations.
Every narrative body section is accounted for; media section hashes exactly match the reviewed prose.
Each distinct article belongs to one bounded media work unit; 333 calendar aliases separately identify an acquisition owner.
All 365 source bodies and headings, including 1,656 English sections, match the actual source strings. All eight complete original language editions match source body and heading strings.
All 333 same-year canonical alias bodies match; deduplication has not removed source prose.
All 140 history commission IDs are unique; none collides with an existing ID, and all existing_related_ids resolve.
Calendar publication slots remain separate from historical dates; source fidelity does not establish historical sign-off.
Missing media does not exclude historical articles from either register.
The media contract requires native decode, identity, context, rights and 4K inspection separately; public access is not permission.

findings.resolution: Register explicitly records missing_heading_indices, per-section heading_status, specific heading-writing tasks, and aggregate 652 articles / 2,024 sections. These are pending work, not finished headings.

findings.resolution: Register explicitly identifies base_content_language=en, available_original_locale_overrides and a separate English restoration override. Documentation explains 365 translated destinations and 699 English fallbacks per complete non-English locale.
